body: Looped language models apply the same stack of layers T times to each token, which deepens the model without adding parameters but multiplies its key-value (KV) cache by T. The larger cache limits how many sequences a GPU can decode at once and slows each decoding step, which reads the whole cache. We propose Hybrid Latent Attention (HLA), which keeps exact keys and values within a sliding window of W recent tokens and stores each older token as a compact latent that the query of each loop reads directly, without reconstructing keys and values. We uptrain HLA on Ouro looped models (T=4) with 1.4B and 2.6B parameters, keeping the pretrained weights frozen and training only the added parameters to reproduce the original attention. The cache shrinks by 10.7x per token, fitting 4.0-8.8x as many concurrent sequences per GPU, and decoding throughput improves by 2.5x at 1K-token contexts and by up to 7.4x at 16K. HLA retains over 97% of the original accuracy on math, knowledge and reasoning benchmarks, and 96-100% on long-context retrieval up to 16K tokens. After supervised fine-tuning, it performs on par with the fine-tuned original model on competition-level math.
summaryZh: 循环语言模型通过对每个Token重复应用相同的层堆栈来加深模型，但这会成倍增加KV缓存并拖慢解码速度。本文提出了混合潜在注意力（HLA），在滑动窗口内保留精确的键值（KV），并将较旧的Token存储为紧凑的潜在表示，供后续循环直接读取而无需重建KV。实验表明，HLA将每Token的缓存缩减了10.7倍，解码吞吐量提升了2.5至7.4倍，同时在数学和长上下文检索基准上保持了97%以上的原始准确率。
